result.description:
Senior Property, Power & Construction Underwriter
Asia Mideast Insurance and Reinsurance Pty Ltd
Location: North Sydney NSW 2060
Employment Type: Full-time
Position: Senior Property, Power & Construction Underwriter


About the Business
Asia Mideast Insurance and Reinsurance Pty Ltd, known as AMIR, is an underwriting agency and Lloyd’s of London Coverholder based in North Sydney, New South Wales.
AMIR focuses on underwriting insurance and reinsurance risks, with particular expertise in complex and specialty risks in Australia and overseas. The business actively underwrites risks across Australia, New Zealand, the Middle East, Asia, Africa and the Indian sub-continent.
AMIR has been operating successfully for 28 years and has developed a strong reputation for technical underwriting expertise, profitable underwriting results, responsive broker service and long-standing relationships across international insurance and reinsurance markets.


About the Role
AMIR is seeking a full time Senior Property, Power & Construction Underwriter to join its North Sydney office.
The successful candidate will be responsible for underwriting property, power and construction insurance and reinsurance risks across Australian and international markets. The role requires advanced technical underwriting capability, strong commercial judgement, experience in high risk property, power and construction exposures, and the ability to work closely with insurance and reinsurance brokers, cedants, capacity providers and internal stakeholders.
This is a senior technical underwriting role which will involve risk assessment, pricing, broker liaison, portfolio development, risk mitigation planning, review of survey and loss information, and training of junior underwriting staff.


Key Duties and Responsibilities
The Senior Property, Power & Construction Underwriter will be responsible for:
•	Underwriting property, power and construction insurance and reinsurance risks in accordance with AMIR’s underwriting authorities, binder requirements and internal procedures. 
•	Assessing complex property, power and construction risks, including exposure, construction type, occupancy, location, loss history, survey findings, policy terms, risk mitigation measures and underwriting suitability. 
•	Reviewing and analysing risk survey reports, engineering information, loss records, policy wordings, slips, endorsements and supporting underwriting documentation. 
•	Preparing underwriting recommendations, pricing, terms, conditions and coverage positions for property, power and construction insurance and reinsurance risks. 
•	Developing technical underwriting plans to manage high-risk exposures across property, power and construction classes of business. 
•	Applying risk modelling techniques and relevant risk assessment tools to evaluate exposure, probable loss and underwriting acceptability. 
•	Reviewing applicable sanctions, territorial issues and compliance considerations relevant to international insurance and reinsurance risks. 
•	Liaising with insurance and reinsurance brokers in Australia and overseas to obtain underwriting information, clarify risk details and negotiate appropriate terms. 
•	Developing and maintaining strong relationships with insurance and reinsurance brokers to support quality business submissions and long term portfolio development. 
•	Attending relevant industry seminars, conferences and market meetings in Australia and overseas. 
•	Undertaking business travel as required to meet insurance and reinsurance brokers, promote AMIR’s underwriting capabilities and increase appropriate business opportunities. 
•	Liaising with loss adjusters and relevant professional advisers in relation to major property, power and construction insurance and reinsurance losses. 
•	Applying Lloyd’s of London risk codes, reporting expectations and underwriting requirements where relevant. 
•	Supporting portfolio monitoring, renewal reviews, underwriting performance analysis and internal reporting. 
•	Training and mentoring an Assistant Underwriter appointed from the Australian market in underwriting processes, broker liaison, risk assessment and business development matters. 


Skills and Experience Required
The successful applicant will be expected to have:
•	Minimum 10 years’ underwriting experience in property, power and construction insurance and/or reinsurance. 
•	Minimum 7 years’ experience underwriting property, power and construction risks in the Middle East. 
•	Demonstrated experience in underwriting high-risk property, power and construction exposures. 
•	Strong familiarity with risk mitigation measures for complex insurance and reinsurance exposures. 
•	Experience using risk modelling techniques and relevant tools for property, power and construction risk assessment. 
•	Strong relationships with insurance and reinsurance brokers across international markets, excluding USA and Canada. 
•	Familiarity with sanctions regimes applicable to international insurance and reinsurance risks. 
•	Ability to review risk survey reports and identify relevant underwriting information required for proper risk assessment. 
•	Experience dealing with international loss adjusting firms in relation to large property, power and construction insurance and reinsurance losses. 
•	Familiarity with Lloyd’s of London risk codes, binder requirements and underwriting standards. 
•	Ability to train junior underwriting staff in technical underwriting, broker liaison and business development matters. 
•	Academic engineering knowledge or engineering-related qualifications to support technical risk assessment. 
•	Proven track record of profitable underwriting results. 
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level attention to detail and ability to work accurately within underwriting guidelines, binder requirements and compliance obligations. 
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant underwriting, reporting, risk assessment or risk modelling systems. 


Qualifications
Relevant qualifications in insurance, reinsurance, engineering, risk management, business, finance or a related field will be highly regarded.
Professional Insurance qualification minimum Diploma in Insurance from the Chartered Insurance Institute in UK, or Australian equivalent. 


How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant property, power and construction underwriting experience.
Applications should be sent to: adel@amir.com.au

For over 45+ years, Walz have been providing specialist maintenance and construction solutions for the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. We take a multi-disciplinary approach to deliver safe, reliable, cost-effective solutions.

The heart of our service delivery is our team of highly skilled, long-term employees who possess a breadth and depth of experience that enables us to support a diverse range of projects. We have offices in Brisbane, Gladstone, and Mackay.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our team of dedicated professionals. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

The Welder is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, and repair of metal structures and components in accordance with engineering drawings and specifications. The role also includes a strong focus on maintaining safe work practices and adhering to environmental management standards, whilst maintaining Walz Group goals and objectives.

Technical Duties
Interpret and work from blueprints, technical drawings, and job specifications to determine project requirements.
Select, clean, and prepare metal stock for fabrication tasks.
Mark, cut, and shape metal components using hand tools, flame-cutting torches, and machine tool.
Bend and form metal parts using mechanical tools and heating/hammering methods.
Align and assemble components using measuring instruments and hand tools.
Join metal parts using welding, bolting, and riveting techniques.
Inspect completed welds for bead width, penetration, and conformance to quality standards.
Finish, clean, and polish fabricated components as required.

Safety Management Duties
Follow and promote compliance with all occupational health and safety (OHS) policies and procedures.
Conduct risk assessments and participate in toolbox talks and safety briefings.
Identify and report hazards, near-misses, and incidents promptly.
Ensure all tools and equipment are used correctly and maintained in safe working order.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
Participate in safety audits and assist in implementing corrective actions.

Environmental Management
Comply with environmental regulations and company policies to minimize environmental impact.
Ensure proper disposal of waste materials, including metal scraps and hazardous substances.
Use environmentally friendly practices where possible in fabrication and finishing processes.
Report environmental hazards and assist in managing spills or contamination incidents.
Contribute to the company's sustainability goals by supporting efficient use of materials and energy.

Skills and Qualifications
Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent).
Proficiency in welding (MIG, TIG, Stick), cutting, and metal forming techniques.
Sound knowledge of workplace health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and plans.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment

Physical Requirements
Ability to work in physically demanding environments including heights, confined spaces, and hot/cold conditions.
Capability to lift heavy materials and operate heavy machinery and tools.
Endurance to stand, bend, and work for extended periods.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: 38 hours $44.63/hr + Super. Guaranteed overtime paid in accordance with the applicable legislative instrument in place.

result.description:
Bennetts Green, NSW, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 15/07/2026 to 12/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17634
- Unit 4 12 Statham St. Bennetts Green NSW 2290
- $81,000 - $85,000
- Full time opportunity with Hancock Automotive

About Us:

Viaan Australia Pty Ltd trading as Hancock Automotive is a trusted automotive service center based in Bennetts Green, proudly serving the Newcastle and Lake Macquarie community since 1998. With over 25 years of experience, the business has built strong relationships with generations of local families by providing reliable automotive services and personalized customer care.

As a boutique workshop, Hancock Automotive combines its long-standing experience with state-of-the-art diagnostic technology to deliver personalized attention and dependable automotive solutions. The team is committed to keeping the local community safe and moving by providing quality mechanical repairs and honest service.

At Hancock Automotive, honesty, community, and quality are the foundation of everything we do. The team believes in transparent advice, treating every Newcastle and Lake Macquarie locals like family, and maintaining high standards in every repair by using quality parts and workmanship.

Whether you need mechanical repairs, brake and clutch services, tyres, fleet servicing, or rego checks, Hancock Automotive is dedicated to providing reliable automotive care that customers can trust.

Position Overview:

As Motor Mechanic at Hancock Automotive you will be responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and repairing vehicles to ensure their optimal performance and safety. The Motor Mechanic role involves diagnostics, repairs, servicing, and safety checks, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards. It also requires clear communication with customers to explain issues and recommend solutions.

Tasks & responsibilities:
- Examine vehicle systems and individual components to identify mechanical faults, excessive wear, or operational defects.
- Remove, dismantle, and reinstall engines, gearboxes, steering systems, and associated vehicle components using approved mechanical procedures.
- Carry out repairs or replace damaged parts to restore vehicle functionality in line with manufacturer and industry standards.
- Ensure that tools and diagnostic equipment are in good working order to prevent delays.
- Utilise computer-based diagnostic tools and electronic testing equipment to detect and analyse mechanical and electrical issues.
- Assemble engines and mechanical systems following repair work, ensuring correct fitting, calibration, and performance.
- Conduct comprehensive checks on systems such as basic electrical, fuel, cooling, and exhaust to ensure proper function.
- Complete routine servicing and preventative maintenance tasks, including oil and fluid replacement, lubrication, and engine adjustments.
- Test vehicle systems after repair or servicing to confirm safe operation and reliable performance.
- Consult service manuals, technical documentation, and manufacturer specifications to support accurate diagnosis and repair processes.
- Assess vehicles for compliance with road safety and emissions requirements and identify necessary corrective work.
- Perform vehicle inspections and, where authorised, issue roadworthiness certification or prepare reports detailing required repairs.
- Keep up to date with manufacturer specifications, automotive technologies, and industry repair methods to ensure high-quality workmanship.
- Learn latest automotive technologies and repair methods to maintain service quality.
- Follow safety protocols during repairs and handling hazardous materials correctly.
- Follow local and national automotive regulations, including emission standards and safety guidelines.

Essential Skills:
- Commitment to delivering high-quality service and ensuring customer satisfaction.
- Efficiently manage tasks to complete repairs and servicing within designated timeframes.
- Stay up to date with the latest automotive technologies and adapt to new vehicle models and diagnostic tools.

Qualifications and Experience:
- Certificate IV in the relevant field.
- Three (3) years of relevant experience

Benefits & Remuneration:
- Salary commensurate with experience. $81,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation.
- Continue to learn and gain experience.

Apply now through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17634.php
